messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline is FDA-approved to treat six conditions in adults:
Major depressive disorder (MDD), the clinical term for depression.
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), where unwanted thoughts drive repeated behaviors.
Panic disorder, which causes sudden attacks of intense fear along with physical symptoms.
Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), which can follow a frightening or traumatic event.
Social anxiety disorder (SAD), also called social phobia.
Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), a severe form of premenstrual symptoms.
In children and teenagers, sertraline is approved only for OCD, from age 6 upward.
Its safety and effectiveness have not been established in children under 6 years of age.
Its safety and effectiveness have not been established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD.
Not every sertraline product is approved for all six conditions:
Sertraline tablets and oral solution are approved for all of them.
Sertraline 150 mg and 200 mg capsules are approved only for depression in adults and for OCD in adults and children aged 6 and over.
Triplet: ["Sertraline", "has fda approval", "treat six conditions in adults"]

The relation 'has fda approval' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has received approval from the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the indication or use specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has approval status': The subject drug has the regulatory approval status specified by the object entity.
B. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
C. 'has fda statement': The subject drug has a statement from the FDA that specifies the information provided by the object entity.
D. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
E. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
